app.subtitle: Local IP reputation analysis, URL scans, DMARC reports and AbuseIPDB reports
app.lang_switch_confirm: Changing the language reloads the page and discards unsaved work (a running analysis or pasted text). Continue?
history.subtitle: Last 25 actions: IP lookups, uploaded DMARC reports and saved e-mail analyses - you can reopen or delete them. "Clear history" removes only IP lookups and DMARC reports; e-mail analyses (which contain the raw messages) are deleted one by one.
history.confirm_delete_email: Delete this analysis together with the saved e-mail?
logs.subtitle: Errors and warnings recorded by individual services - normal, error-free operation of Seisa leaves no trace here.
logs.empty: No entries in the selected range - good news, nothing failed.
lookup.subtitle: Check the reputation of an IP address in several independent threat-intelligence sources at once (VirusTotal, AlienVault OTX, Cloudflare Radar, AbuseIPDB, GreyNoise, WHOIS/rDNS) and see one aggregate risk score.
lookup.batch_hint: Paste IP addresses, one per line
urlscan.subtitle: Submit a live scan of a suspicious URL to urlscan.io - you get a detailed report on the page content, network traffic, detected technologies and verdict without opening the link yourself.
urlscan.banner: The scan is always submitted with "unlisted" visibility (hidden from the urlscan.io front page and public search results, visible to verified security researchers in urlscan Pro). User agent: default. Scan country: automatic.
urlscan.no_uuid: urlscan.io did not return a scan identifier.
urlscan.submitted: Scan submitted - waiting for the result...
urlscan.still_running: The scan is still running after {time} - check manually
md.service.virustotal: Detection ratio from antivirus engines, reputation, ASN, categories, tags and WHOIS.
md.service.otx: Number and names of threat-intel pulses linked to this indicator, geolocation, ASN.
md.service.cloudflare: Network/context data - ASN, location, routing. This is not a reputation verdict.
md.service.abuseipdb: Abuse confidence score, number of reports, author of the latest report, ISP, usage type.
md.service.greynoise: Whether the address is known 'internet noise' (mass scanners/bots) or something unusual.
md.service.whois: WHOIS record of a domain or reverse DNS (PTR) of an IP address - a direct protocol query, with no external account and no single source website.
dmarc.subtitle: Upload aggregate DMARC reports (XML) from mail providers to see which servers send messages on behalf of your domain, whether they pass SPF/DKIM and their alignment, and which IP addresses look suspicious.
dmarc.drop_multiple: You can upload several reports at once
dmarc.no_auth_data: no auth_results/{section} data in this record
dmarc.no_records: No records to display in the selected files.
dmarc.alignment_help: Alignment: "r" = relaxed (subdomains allowed), "s" = strict (the domain must match exactly). Policy p/sp: none/quarantine/reject for the main domain / subdomains, pct = percentage of messages the policy applies to.
